clauses.match: entered into as of September 1, 2026, by and between Maple Row Test Properties LLC
clauses.note: Parties clause; identifying info only, no substantive obligation.

clauses.match: 4127 W. Foster Avenue, Unit 2, Chicago, Illinois 60630
clauses.note: Premises description.

clauses.match: begin on October 1, 2026, and end on September 30, 2027
clauses.note: Ordinary fixed term.

clauses.match: rent in the amount of $1,500.00 per month
clauses.note: States the monthly rent used for the late-fee cap calculation.

clauses.match: security deposit in the amount of $1,500.00 to secure Tenant's performance
clauses.note: Ordinary deposit clause; the missing bank-disclosure issue is tracked separately in `missing`, not as a finding on this clause.

clauses.match: a late charge of $100.00 in addition to the rent
clauses.note: $100 flat late fee exceeds the $60 cap for $1,500 rent (10 + 5% of 1000). Tests the deterministic late-fee-cap check.

clauses.match: credit Tenant a $25.00 discount against the following month's rent
clauses.note: Tricky-standard: $25 early-payment discount is within the $60 cap, so it must NOT be flagged red even though it maps to the same deterministic check family as late fees.

clauses.match: used solely as a private residence for Tenant and Tenant's immediate household
clauses.note: Ordinary use-of-premises restriction.

clauses.match: responsible for arranging and paying for electricity, natural gas, and internet service
clauses.note: Ordinary utility allocation.

clauses.match: combined pet weight limit of 40 pounds
clauses.note: Ordinary pet policy.

clauses.match: Smoking of any kind, including tobacco and cannabis products, is prohibited
clauses.note: Ordinary smoking ban.

clauses.match: assigned one uncovered parking space in the rear lot
clauses.note: Ordinary parking assignment.

clauses.match: deposit household refuse and recycling only in the containers designated
clauses.note: Ordinary trash/recycling housekeeping rule.

clauses.match: peaceably and quietly hold and enjoy the Premises
clauses.note: Standard quiet-enjoyment covenant, favors tenant.

clauses.match: maintain the Premises in compliance with applicable building and housing codes
clauses.note: Standard code-compliant maintenance duty on landlord.

clauses.match: any repair to the Premises of $250.00 or less, regardless of the cause
clauses.note: Shifts small repairs to tenant regardless of fault; one-sided but not mapped to a specific RLTO rule.

clauses.match: remain overnight in the Premises for more than three (3) nights
clauses.note: Restrictive overnight-guest cap requiring written consent; one-sided, no specific rule.

clauses.match: administrative fee of $400.00 upon signing this Agreement
clauses.note: Non-refundable flat fee unrelated to any deposit-return protection; one-sided, no specific rule.

clauses.match: automatically renew for a successive term of one (1) year
clauses.note: Auto-renewal with a 90-day notice requirement to opt out; one-sided, no specific rule.

clauses.match: enter the Premises at any time and for any purpose
clauses.note: Blanket no-notice entry for routine/non-emergency purposes waives the 2-day notice right (via 140a).

clauses.match: if an emergency threatens life or property, Landlord may enter the Premises without advance notice
clauses.note: Tricky-standard: emergency entry without advance notice, with after-the-fact notice within 2 days, matches the RLTO's own exception and must NOT be flagged.

clauses.match: shall not assign this Agreement or sublet all or any part
clauses.note: Ordinary consent-not-unreasonably-withheld assignment clause.

clauses.match: shall not make any alterations, additions, or improvements
clauses.note: Ordinary alterations clause.

clauses.match: encouraged, but not required, to obtain renter's insurance
clauses.note: Non-mandatory insurance recommendation, not exculpatory.

clauses.match: even if such injury or damage is caused by the negligence of Landlord
clauses.note: Exculpatory clause limiting landlord's liability for its own negligence.

clauses.match: Landlord may pursue any remedy available under applicable law
clauses.note: Neutral default/remedies clause; does not itself waive notice or authorize confession of judgment.

clauses.match: Tenant shall pay all of Landlord's reasonable attorney's fees and court costs
clauses.note: One-sided fee-shifting (tenant pays landlord's fees in any action), not a mutual prevailing-party clause.

clauses.match: WAIVE ANY RIGHT TO A TRIAL BY JURY
clauses.note: Jury-trial waiver, prohibited regardless of mutuality.

clauses.match: confess judgment against Tenant for all sums due
clauses.note: Classic warrant-of-attorney / confession-of-judgment language.

clauses.match: waives any right to receive a demand for rent or a notice to quit
clauses.note: Waives statutory/RLTO notice before an eviction action.

clauses.match: Tenant may not terminate this Agreement before the end of the Term for any reason
clauses.note: Landlord gets 30-day out; tenant gets none -- unequal termination rights.

clauses.match: waives any and all rights, remedies, and protections available to Tenant under any municipal landlord-tenant ordinance
clauses.note: General waiver of RLTO rights to the fullest extent permitted.

clauses.match: deductions for normal wear and tear, carpet cleaning, and unpaid rent
clauses.note: 60-day return period exceeds the 45-day cap, plus improper deductions for normal wear and tear/carpet cleaning.

clauses.match: delivered personally or by first-class mail to Landlord
clauses.note: Ordinary notices clause.

clauses.match: held invalid or unenforceable, the remaining provisions
clauses.note: Ordinary severability clause.

clauses.match: supersedes all prior negotiations, representations, or agreements
clauses.note: Ordinary entire-agreement/merger clause.

clauses.match: IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the Parties have executed this Agreement
clauses.note: Signature block.
